name: LTX-2 — video to video (canny edges + audio)
description:
Re-imagine a video while keeping its motion. Upload a source video and a start image: the outlines of every frame are traced (canny edge detection) and LTX-2 paints a brand-new video that follows those lines exactly, in the look of your start image and prompt, with a freshly generated soundtrack (the original audio is not kept). Canny keeps shapes and silhouettes very strictly — good for restyling while preserving every contour. For looser, more creative results use the depth-control version.

The start image becomes the first frame of the result — a restyled still of your video's first frame works best (you can make one with an image-editing workflow). Tick "Ignore the start image" to let the prompt alone set the look; the form still asks for an image, but it is not used. In the prompt, describe the scene, the action as it unfolds and the sounds you want.

Your video is cropped to the chosen width × height and only its first frames are used (121 frames ≈ 5 s at 24 fps). This model runs a 20-step first pass and then a 2× upscale pass, so it is one of the slower video workflows — bigger sizes and more frames make it much slower.

exposedParameters.default: A wide shot reveals a whimsical outdoor scene with a decorative tree-like structure crafted from brown branches. Golden spherical ornaments and delicate white artificial flowers adorn the branches, catching bright daylight. A small grey and white squirrel stands on a round, light-colored wooden platform at the base, its bushy tail slightly raised. The squirrel dips its head down, nibbling at something on the platform. The camera slowly pushes in, focusing on the squirrel's gentle movements. Soft forest sounds fill the air—rustling leaves, distant birdsong, and a gentle breeze. The golden ornaments shimmer in the sunlight as the squirrel continues to eat.
